class.name: CitySim
class.brief_description: The game's connection to the C++ simulation.
class.description: The one node GDScript uses to control and observe the simulation (architecture §11). The game registers it as the autoload [code]Sim[/code]. For now it only reports the version of the simulation core it is linked with.

method.name: get_core_version
method.description: Returns the version of the simulation core library, for example [code]0.0.1[/code].
